description: List the filings on a US FEDERAL district or bankruptcy court docket — every complaint, motion, order and exhibit RECAP has recorded for that case, in filing order, with the document id, entry number, filing date, page count and a link to the PDF. This is the docket sheet: what was filed, when, and by which entry number. Each filing reports whether its PDF is actually held (`pdf_available`); RECAP holds the docket text for far more filings than it holds documents, so treat a filing with no PDF as a real filing whose document nobody has purchased yet, not as a missing record. Takes the docket_id from search_dockets. Court opinions are a different thing and live in search_case_law / get_opinion.

docket_id.description: Docket id from search_dockets (the docket_id field).

name: list_docket_filings
